_note: measured words-per-minute per TTS voice; written by `plan_runtime.py measure`
_style_warning: A voice's wpm is NOT a constant — it depends on the WRITING STYLE as much as the voice. en-US-JennyNeural measured 180.3 on a dense script (29-word average sentences) and 150.3 on a plain-language rewrite of the SAME video (8-word average sentences), at identical speed settings: a 17% swing, because every full stop is a pause and short sentences have far more of them. The rates here now reflect the short-sentence style that CLAUDE.md GROWTH RULE 6 mandates, so they are the right predictor going forward. But RE-MEASURE after any real change in writing style, not just when switching voice — budgeting a punchy script at a dense script's rate over-writes it by ~17%, which is what happened on re-closing-costs 2026-08-03 (2,320 words budgeted for 13 min actually ran 15.4).
